buckets.title: In-game message-board posts
buckets.intro: Everything else on the in-game noticeboard: school events, monthly notices, student diaries, ghost gossip, and concert announcements.

entries.title: STUDY ABROAD NEWS
entries.body_html:
<name> will be going to
study overseas. We'll surely
get a little lonely around here.

entries.title: STUDY ABROAD NEWS
entries.body_html:
<name> has returned safely
from studying overseas. Welcome
home!

entries.title: A NEW ARRIVAL
entries.body_html:
A new pupil named <name>
has joined our school. I hope
you all become good friends.

entries.title: AN "A" FOR EFFORT
entries.body_html:
<name> has been selected
as last month's hardest working
student. Congratulations!

entries.title: TEA PARTY UPDATE
entries.body_html:
The spring tea party will take
place next month. Host friends
and learn about courtesy.

entries.title: TEA PARTY UPDATE
entries.body_html:
This week, I will be reviewing
everyone's tea party skills near
the park. Please do your best!

entries.title: TEA PARTY UPDATE
entries.body_html:
Thanks to you all for making the
tea party so much fun. Now don't
forget how to act with kindness.

entries.title: TEA PARTY UPDATE
entries.body_html:
This year's tea party was a big
success. I really hope everyone
can take part next year, though.

entries.title: Test of Courage
entries.body_html:
Next month, our traditional
test of courage will be held.
Brave souls, gather round!

entries.title: TEST OF COURAGE COMPETITION NEWS
entries.body_html:
The test of courage competition
will be held this week. I hope
to witness your acts of bravery.

entries.title: TEST OF COURAGE COMPETITION NEWS
entries.body_html:
Thanks to the competition, I was
able to watch all of you act so
bravely. It was most wonderful.

entries.title: TEST OF COURAGE COMPETITION NEWS
entries.body_html:
We had an excellent competition
this year. However, some people
did not participate.

entries.title: MUSHROOM HOTPOT COOKOFF UPDATE
entries.body_html:
Let's all pick mushrooms next
month! We'll enjoy a taste of
fall and have a big party!

entries.title: MUSHROOM HOTPOT COOKOFF UPDATE
entries.body_html:
For this week's event, we've set
things up in Fungi Forest. So,
start picking those mushrooms!

entries.title: MUSHROOM HOTPOT COOKOFF UPDATE
entries.body_html:
Thanks to you all, the cookoff
was a huge success! I already
can't wait for next year!

entries.title: MUSHROOM HOTPOT COOKOFF UPDATE
entries.body_html:
The cookoff came and went
smoothly. Though, it's a shame
some students didn't take part.

entries.title: RAINBOW SNOW FESTIVAL UPDATE
entries.body_html:
Next month, we will conduct a
ritual using snowflakes. I need
you to collect many of them.

entries.title: RAINBOW SNOW FESTIVAL UPDATE
entries.body_html:
Have you been able to gather up
any snowflakes? If so, I will
hold onto them.

entries.title: RAINBOW SNOW FESTIVAL UPDATE
entries.body_html:
Thanks to all of you, we had a
spectacular event. Let's put in
a big effort next year, too!

entries.title: RAINBOW SNOW FESTIVAL UPDATE
entries.body_html:
The participants all worked
hard, but I hope everyone can
collect snowflakes next year.

entries.title: NEW YEARS COUNTDOWN NOTICE
entries.body_html:
Let's all celebrate together on
New Year's Eve by counting in
the New Year.

entries.title: NEW YEARS MESSAGE
entries.body_html:
I would like to wish a happy New
Year to everyone! May you enjoy
great success in the year ahead.

entries.title: Be Good for Christmas!
entries.body_html:
Everyone's favorite time
of the year has arrived!
I hope you get a present!

entries.title: HOW WAS YOUR CHRISTMAS?
entries.body_html:
Did you get some presents and
have a nice Christmas? I can't
wait for next year already!

entries.title: BAD CHILDREN FORBIDDEN TO GO OUT
entries.body_html:
Children who have behaved badly
are not allowed to go outside.
Stay in your room quietly.

entries.title: GOODBYE WINTER
entries.body_html:
Winter is ending and spring is
near. Soon enough, we will enjoy
some warm weather.

entries.title: Familiar Class
entries.body_html:
There will be a special
class about familiars held.
Be there!

entries.title: GOLEM CONTEST
entries.body_html:
A contest will be held to select
the number-one golem! Let's
work together to win!

entries.title: Homunculus Class
entries.body_html:
There will be a special
class about homunculi
held. Be there!

entries.title: RAIN WARNING
entries.body_html:
The weather is bad this time of
year. It can rain many days in a
row. Be careful not to get sick.

entries.title: BE KIND TO PLANTS
entries.body_html:
The flowers don't look so
healthy right now. We really
need to water them often!

entries.title: A TRAVELER HAS ARRIVED
entries.body_html:
Let's become better friends
with him through music!

entries.title: Halloween is Here!
entries.body_html:
The Halloween season has
arrived! Trick or Treat!

entries.title: DO YOU BELIEVE IN FAIRIES?
entries.body_html:
Only people who think fairies
are real can see them. It's
important to have some faith.

entries.title: BEWARE OF THE YETI!!!
entries.body_html:
Very large footprints have been
found on the ground. Everyone,
please be careful!

entries.title: Phantasm Wasting Time
entries.body_html:
No interesting news lately.
Doesn't anyone have any
interesting stories?

entries.title: Phantasm Wasting Time
entries.body_html:
I've got lots of friends over
there on the other side, you
know. I really do! Hahaha!

entries.title: Phantasm Wasting Time
entries.body_html:
There's nothing more
interesting than the
misery of others. Hahaha...!

entries.title: Phantasm Wasting Time
entries.body_html:
Request from Phantasm...
Summon me in the girls'
toilet, please.

entries.title: Phantasm Wasting Time
entries.body_html:
I wonder who my soulmate is...
Oh well. Doesn't matter.

entries.title: Phantasm Wasting Time
entries.body_html:
Huh? Why do I know so much?!
Hahaha...! Are you sure you want
to know? Too bad! I won't tell!

entries.title: Phantasm Wasting Time
entries.body_html:
Oh, come on! Enough already!
Summoned again today. I'm so
sick of it...

entries.title: Phantasm Wasting Time
entries.body_html:
I'm an extremely honest person.
Really! I swear! I've never told
a lie in my life! Hahaha...!

entries.title: Phantasm Wasting Time
entries.body_html:
You can't depend on me
all the time. You have
to rely on yourself alone.

entries.title: Phantasm Wasting Time
entries.body_html:
It's hard for people to make up
once things turn ugly, isn't it?
Although...it is fun to watch!

entries.title: Phantasm Wasting Time
entries.body_html:
People who get bad news from
me are really unfortunate,
aren't they? Hahaha...!

entries.title: Phantasm Wasting Time
entries.body_html:
Telling someone that their
darling likes someone else is
one of my favorites. Hahaha...!

entries.title: Warashi Child's Diary
entries.body_html:
Today I made my first
friend! I'm so happy!

entries.title: WARASHI DIARY
entries.body_html:
I miss that kid... I wish
I could play with them again.

entries.title: Warashi Child's Diary
entries.body_html:
I've got a best friend now
who always comes and visits! I
really enjoy our time together!

entries.title: I got in trouble...
entries.body_html:
I got in trouble when the
teacher caught me passing
notes in class the other day.

entries.title: A Glutton's Haiku
entries.body_html:
My stomach does growl.
I am so very hungry
I might just pass out.

entries.title: A Big Catch!
entries.body_html:
Boy, did I catch a lot on my
recent fishing adventure!
A lot of garbage, that is...

entries.title: Fighting is Bad
entries.body_html:
I recently argued with a friend,
and things got pretty bad, but
I apologized and was forgiven.

entries.title: My Stomach Hurts
entries.body_html:
I guess you really shouldn't
overeat. My stomach hurts
from it, and I'm gaining weight.

entries.title: For the Future
entries.body_html:
I'm studying as much as possible
in order to become the best
wizard that I can possibly be.

entries.title: When I look in the mirror...
entries.body_html:
I am so cool! When I go to the
bathroom, I end up staring at
myself in the mirror for ages!

entries.title: My Secret
entries.body_html:
I have a secret. I can't ride
a broom very well! Ahhh! It's
so embarrassing...!

entries.title: No running?!
entries.body_html:
Running in the hallways is
dangerous! You could trip
and fall like I did!

entries.title: Mushrooms in My House
entries.body_html:
After being out of the house for
a while, mushrooms grew all over
the place! I was so surprised!

entries.title: Looking Up in the Sky
entries.body_html:
I saw a beautiful shooting
star flying across the sky.
I wish I'd made a wish...

entries.title: Advice for Worries
entries.body_html:
I'm an attention seeker, so
I make sure I always fail at
magic. What should I do?

entries.title: A Fated Meeting
entries.body_html:
Every time I see my dearest,
I get goose bumps. There's no
doubt about it... I'm in love.

entries.title: Toilet Cleaning
entries.body_html:
Recently, the teacher got angry
and made me clean the toilets.
And now they're squeaky clean!

entries.title: My First Best Friend
entries.body_html:
I've got a best friend now!
Everything we do together is
fun! Best friends are great!

entries.title: I CAN'T STAND BUGS
entries.body_html:
As I was walking around town the
other day, I saw a bug with so
many legs. I had to scream!

entries.title: MY DIET PLAN
entries.body_html:
I was gonna be late for school,
so I ran all the way from home.
Guess what, I lost five pounds!

entries.title: HOOKED ON SWEETS
entries.body_html:
I keep wanting to eat candy.
But I know if I do, I'll get
fat. Oh, what should I do?

entries.title: CLUMSY OLD ME
entries.body_html:
The other day, I bought this
new outfit, but then I fell,
so now it's all ruined.

entries.title: ANY TAKERS?
entries.body_html:
I have so many love letters that
I don't need. Does anybody want
them? I'll give them to you.

entries.title: MY DREAM FOR THE FUTURE
entries.body_html:
I want to get married when I
grow up. It's no big deal if I
don't become a great wizard.

entries.title: WHAT I WANT IN A HUSBAND
entries.body_html:
1) Has lots of money
2) Shares the same values as me
3) Is very helpful

entries.title: KNIGHT ON A WHITE HORSE
entries.body_html:
I hope, one day, my prince will
come for me. I'm right here
waiting, sweetheart!

entries.title: IT'S HARD TO BE FRIENDS
entries.body_html:
It's tough for boys and girls to
be friends. Out of nowhere, you
just start liking each other.

entries.title: THE PERFECT DATE
entries.body_html:
We chase after one another on
the beach at summertime and then
stare into each other's eyes.

entries.title: I'VE FALLEN IN LOVE
entries.body_html:
But he only cares about catching
bugs and never notices me. And
many other girls like him, too.

entries.title: WHAT EXACTLY IS CREAMY SKIN?
entries.body_html:
Someone said I have creamy skin.
That means my skin would go well
with a bunch of strawberries?

entries.title: I TRIED A NEW HAIRSTYLE
entries.body_html:
I cut my long hair really short!
It feels nice, but people might
think someone broke my heart.

entries.title: PEOPLE WERE GOSSIPING ABOUT ME
entries.body_html:
Just because I was walking with
a boy, someone started a crazy
rumor about me. How annoying!

entries.title: GETTING FLOWERS
entries.body_html:
We girls are such pushovers when
it comes to getting flowers.
Won't someone give some to me?

entries.title: Bye, Nessie!
entries.body_html:
I'm full now, so I can go
home. Let's meet again
sometime. Bye-bye!

entries.title: Keep River Clean
entries.body_html:
No littering in the river!
Absolutely NO trash dumping!
It stinks enough already!

entries.title: What did it taste like?
entries.body_html:
I wanna know what candyflowers
taste like. I hope I get a
chance to taste one someday.

entries.title: Teacher is a Worrywart
entries.body_html:
We need to try harder to
make sure the teachers don't
worry so much about us!

entries.title: What Matters
entries.body_html:
If something important goes
missing, anyone would be mad.
Who took my snack?!

entries.title: Love Is Hard
entries.body_html:
Ever since I met Unicorn,
I've been thinking a lot
about love. It's so hard!

entries.title: Want to Go Home?
entries.body_html:
Just get the Sphinx's riddle
wrong on purpose! Hee hee,
I'm so smart!

entries.title: Found Treasure?
entries.body_html:
We all searched so hard
together back then.
Those memories are my treasure.

entries.title: Take care of yourself!
entries.body_html:
Seems you got hurt real bad,
but I'm glad you're better.
Try not to get hurt again!

entries.title: What is Mars like?
entries.body_html:
I wonder what it's like. Are
there more of those creatures
like that Martian who visited?

entries.title: Don't blame others!
entries.body_html:
Doing something bad and then
blaming it on someone else is
really rotten!

entries.title: More Irritating than Scary
entries.body_html:
The noise every night was so
bothersome I couldn't sleep!
I'll sleep soundly now though.

entries.title: Good for Thom!
entries.body_html:
Death was stalking Thom,
so I was worried for a while,
but I'm glad he's safe now.

entries.title: Beat the Sleep!
entries.body_html:
I refuse to give in to
drowsiness anymore.
I'm stronger than that!

entries.title: Even Bad Kids…
entries.body_html:
My hair got changed on me…
But honestly? I kinda like
this new style!

entries.title: Victoryyy!
entries.body_html:
I joined boot camp too and
worked up a great sweat!

entries.title: Weird Chime
entries.body_html:
I hated it at first, but now
I kinda miss it. Wonder if
Gremlin will come back…

entries.title: Splash Damage
entries.body_html:
I get why you're upset,
but trashing someone's
house? Not cool.

entries.title: Strong, As Ever
entries.body_html:
Tag was so much fun!
But wow, the Ogre was good!
They're really strong at tag!

entries.title: Plant Care
entries.body_html:
Plants are living things.
Care for them properly,
and you'll connect hearts.

entries.title: Jack Frost Party
entries.body_html:
What kind of party does
Jack Frost throw?
Lots of snowmen maybe?

entries.title: Let's meet again!
entries.body_html:
The homunculus went on
a trip. I wonder if I'll ever
see him again. I hope so!

entries.title: Familiar Summon
entries.body_html:
A super energetic Familiar
popped out! What a surprise.
I wanted to be friends!

entries.title: The Mermaid's Personality
entries.body_html:
She had such a beautiful voice,
but her personality... I bet
the prince was shocked, too.

entries.title: The Siren's Beauty
entries.body_html:
You are my moon and my sun, too
beautiful for words, even though
I only saw you from behind.

entries.title: Yeti's Spell
entries.body_html:
What happens when Yeti casts
a flower spell? Do giant
blossoms rain down?

entries.title: The Truth about the Wild Hound
entries.body_html:
Everyone thought he was so
scary, but he was actually
pretty cute.

entries.title: New Home
entries.body_html:
I hope you find a new home
on your travels! The sewers
were just a bit lacking.

entries.title: Underground Home
entries.body_html:
What's life like down there?
His clothes must get
so dirty…

entries.title: I wonder what it says...
entries.body_html:
I wonder what's written in that
book. It could be the teachers'
diaries or something!

entries.title: Weird Jack-o?
entries.body_html:
Jack-o-Lantern didn't want
any candy.
I worked so hard on it…

entries.title: Time Journey
entries.body_html:
I'd love to visit the past!
If I went back in time,
I'd meet my younger self.

entries.title: Spirited Away
entries.body_html:
Imagine suddenly appearing
somewhere you don't know.
How scary!

entries.title: Nightmare Dream
entries.body_html:
Nightmare showed me a truly
terrifying nightmare.
Just remembering it is scary!

entries.title: Do dreams taste good?
entries.body_html:
What do dreams taste like?
Are sweet dreams sweet?
Are bitter dreams bitter?

entries.title: Does it really exist?
entries.body_html:
I've heard rumors about it,
but does the other world really
exist? Is it a scary place?

entries.title: Thanks, Satyr!
entries.body_html:
Playing with everyone was
so much fun!
Let's jam together again!

entries.title: Fairy's Party
entries.body_html:
I wish I could've gone to
Fairy's party too!
Next time I won't be scared.

To Santa
Thanks for the presents!
This year, I'll give
YOU a present instead!

entries.title: Unidentified Flying Object
entries.body_html:
UFOs look...delicious! They
look like giant donuts! Whoa...!
Now I'm hungry!

entries.title: Request from the Principal
entries.body_html:
Good children shouldn't play
dangerous tricks like the wind
weasel does! Not ever!

entries.title: Mystery Circle
entries.body_html:
There was some strange writing,
but what did it mean? How could
it have got there?

entries.title: Two as One
entries.body_html:
Friends like the Dullahans,
who understand each other…
Aww, I'm so jealous!

entries.title: No Fair!
entries.body_html:
You've been hoarding my
favorite mushrooms all to
yourself! I'm so jealous!!

entries.title: What a Jerk!
entries.body_html:
Why does Dot always cause
so much trouble?
I wish he'd just stop!

entries.title: Effort Matters
entries.body_html:
Harpy used to be so bad, but
now she's amazing! I gotta
follow her example!

entries.title: THANKS FOR BUYING THOSE MATCHES
entries.body_html:
Um...
Thank you, everybody, for
buying all those matches.

entries.title: The Kraken's Ring
entries.body_html:
Did the kraken get married? But
where would he wear the ring?
Does he have a ring tentacle?

entries.title: GOLEM CONTEST RESULTS
entries.body_html:
The golem we all helped to make
won first prize! Thanks for
your hard work, everyone.

entries.title: Soaked Class!
entries.body_html:
Who did this!?
The classroom is soaking wet!
Culprit must clean it up!

entries.title: Leprechaun Gold
entries.body_html:
Didn't find the treasure,
but the dud slips were
funny enough for me!

entries.title: Hot, hot, hot!
entries.body_html:
It's too hot when it's this
sunny out! Can't we do
anything about it?

entries.title: Fair Weather Days
entries.body_html:
Nice weather puts me in a good
mood. Do you think the weather
is connected to our feelings?

entries.title: Giving it my all?!
entries.body_html:
The sun is out today, so I'm
ready to give it my all and work
hard on my...napping. Zzz...

entries.title: It might rain soon...
entries.body_html:
So I'll use magic to make it
sunny. But wait... What were
those words again...?!

entries.title: The Color of the Sky
entries.body_html:
The sky is black! Is this a sign
of something to come? Or is
someone messing with magic?

entries.title: I can't get in the mood...
entries.body_html:
Today is just a bad day. It's
cloudy out, too. I think I'll
just stay in bed...

entries.title: Still Not Done
entries.body_html:
When is the rain going to stop?
Do I really have to wait until
tomorrow?

entries.title: I love rainy days
entries.body_html:
Puddles are so much fun! Splish
splash my feet in the puddles!
But now my clothes are dirty...

entries.title: Rainy Days
entries.body_html:
The rain makes my room damp,
my clothes wet, and me feel
awful. Rain, rain, go away...!

entries.title: I thought it was cold!
entries.body_html:
And now it's snowing! The rain
has turned to snow! I wonder
if it's going to get any colder.

entries.title: Snowy Days
entries.body_html:
Watching the falling snow
calms me, but how does it
affect others?

entries.title: White Sweets from Snow
entries.body_html:
I wonder how many snow cones
you could make from all the
snow. It's too cold to think...!

entries.title: Concert Today!
entries.body_html:
Time: Today
Place: Auditorium
Everyone come on down!

entries.title: Feelings Matter
entries.body_html:
Even if words don't reach,
heartfelt emotions will
always get through.

entries.title: Be Careful!
entries.body_html:
Catching too many fish might
dirty the river, even if
they're tasty. Be careful!

entries.title: Lots of Sweets
entries.body_html:
I said I like candy and got
a TON of it!
Hope they come back soon!

entries.title: What Happened?
entries.body_html:
The headmaster doesn't look
so good today.
Did something happen?

entries.title: Their Relation?
entries.body_html:
Poltergeist's room had a big
Q written in it… Could it
be Quicksilver wrote it?!

entries.title: Love Is Hard
entries.body_html:
Just 'cause you like someone
doesn't mean you get them.
Ugh, it's so hard...

entries.title: Did You Do It?
entries.body_html:
How was that quiz?
It was way too hard
for me…

entries.title: Lots of Money
entries.body_html:
I dug a hole and found a ton
of money buried there!
Is this what they call loot?

entries.title: Don't Be Mad
entries.body_html:
They really tried their best,
even if things got messy.
Let's cut them some slack!

entries.title: Skull Garden
entries.body_html:
I wonder if Mars is covered
in skull flowers right now?
I'd love to see it someday!

entries.title: Satisfied?
entries.body_html:
If this satisfied you,
Doppelganger, then please
stop causing trouble.

entries.title: Just Normal
entries.body_html:
If Wolfman was already a wolf
from the start, that's just
normal, isn't it?

entries.title: Your Job?
entries.body_html:
I know you love music, but
aren't you working as a
Reaper? Well, peace is good!

From Headmaster
Everyone's been so engaged
in class lately!
It makes me very happy.

entries.title: Victoryyy!
entries.body_html:
Walking alone counts as
exercise? What a surprise!
I'll keep it up!

entries.title: Musical Talent
entries.body_html:
Gremlin can compose songs!
I wonder if I have that
kind of talent too?

entries.title: How Rude!
entries.body_html:
Stealing from the same person
TWICE? What a bad kid!

entries.title: What Game?
entries.body_html:
I saw the oni playing a game
that wasn't tag.
Should've asked to join!

entries.title: Who Was That?
entries.body_html:
I was pulling weeds when
someone I'd never seen
smiled at me. Who were they?

entries.title: So Jealous!
entries.body_html:
Someone told me all about the
feast they ate at a party.
I'm so jealous!

entries.title: Welcome Back!
entries.body_html:
You've grown so much while
you were away! We missed you.
Is this what parents feel?

entries.title: A Noble Heart
entries.body_html:
You may be trying a bit hard,
but wanting to help others
is truly admirable!

entries.title: Big Chance!
entries.body_html:
Let's start a trend so huge
even mermaids will hear
about it!

entries.title: Siren's Song
entries.body_html:
They say she sings beautifully,
but she never performs!
Oh, the mystery of it all…

entries.title: Studying Hard!
entries.body_html:
Coming here to learn spells?
What a dedicated student!
We should all follow suit!

entries.title: Cute Surprise
entries.body_html:
Heard they were scary, but
became friends and now I see
they're actually cute!

entries.title: Did He Like It?
entries.body_html:
Did Tom like the bouquet
I gave him?
I bet he did!

entries.title: Underground Meal
entries.body_html:
What does Subterranean eat
for a full-course meal?
Is it all made of rocks?

entries.title: Destiny?
entries.body_html:
Destiny isn't predetermined.
That's total nonsense!
You decide it yourself!

entries.title: All Alone
entries.body_html:
People from another world
live all by themselves.
Isn't that lonely?

entries.title: Friendship Wins
entries.body_html:
Real friends know each other
inside and out -- you can't
fool 'em!

entries.title: Hard Worker?
entries.body_html:
They must've worked really
hard to power up and
overcome their weakness!

entries.title: Happy Dreams
entries.body_html:
Lately I've been having such
happy dreams every night.
I hope they never end!

entries.title: Lost Kid
entries.body_html:
Even a soul gets lonely
when it's lost.
At least, I think so.

entries.title: Jam Session
entries.body_html:
As a musician, I'd love for
someone to sing along with
my performance!

entries.title: Saw a Fairy?
entries.body_html:
Did everyone see the fairy?
As for me…
That's a secret!

entries.title: Chimes Popular?
entries.body_html:
Lots of people have been
changing their door chimes.
Everyone loves music, huh?

entries.title: Revenge Failed!
entries.body_html:
My washtub revenge spell got
totally dodged every time!
That's Kamaitachi for you.

entries.title: Help Wanted
entries.body_html:
I saw that weird writing again…
How do you even make those?
Anyone know? Please tell me!

entries.title: Body or Brain?
entries.body_html:
Does your tummy rumble because
you want to eat, or do you
want to eat because it rumbles?

entries.title: Likes/Dislikes
entries.body_html:
I can't imagine eating food
I hate and suddenly liking
it. That's impossible!

entries.title: Misjudged!
entries.body_html:
He looked tough, but he even
decorates with flowers.
There's a sensitive side!

entries.title: Sessions Are Fun
entries.body_html:
The more people who join in,
the more fun
sessions become!

entries.title: Presents Change
entries.body_html:
This is all thanks to
everyone!
Thank you so much!

entries.title: Rich Kid?
entries.body_html:
You had rings on ALL ten
fingers? Are you secretly
loaded or something?

entries.title: Golem Set Done
entries.body_html:
Beautiful Golem accessories
are now finished!
Thanks for your help!

entries.title: Try Talking
entries.body_html:
Kappa's actually really easy
to talk to! I had them all
wrong this whole time.

entries.title: Brain Smoke!
entries.body_html:
Thought about it all day long
but still don't get it…
I used to understand this…

entries.title: Winter's End…
entries.body_html:
Someone has come with a favor
to ask. Please lend an ear
before spring arrives!

entries.title: Familiar Spell
entries.body_html:
Do you remember yours?
Now might be your chance
to meet them again!

entries.title: Golem Contest
entries.body_html:
A contest to see whose golem
looks best with gem jewelry!
Everyone, please participate!

entries.title: Almost Time
entries.body_html:
It's about time for
Homunculus classes again.
How are they doing?

entries.title: Rain-Loving Kid
entries.body_html:
He wants to make more friends.
Would you talk with him?

entries.title: Keep Town Clean
entries.body_html:
Pull weeds to help make our
town beautiful! Someone
will surely appreciate it.

entries.title: Traveler Returns
entries.body_html:
He's back in town!
A chance to learn about
the joy of music!

entries.title: Seen a Fairy?
entries.body_html:
If you have, try your best
to become friends with one
next time, okay?

entries.title: Big Foot Returns
entries.body_html:
Giant footprints spotted
around town once more.
Could HE be back?
